svg.title: Multi-workload migration topology
svg.desc: Topology showing VMware servers moving through Azure Migrate, SQL Server through Database Migration Service, and files through AzCopy to separate Azure targets.

g.aria-label: server discovery and replication: source-wave to server-migration
online database stream: source-wave to database-migration
staged file copy: source-wave to file-transfer
test migration and cutover: server-migration to compute-target
validated database cutover: database-migration to database-target
hash-verified object transfer: file-transfer to storage-target
Service node: VMware SQL and file sources
Service node: IaaS and PaaS targets

svg.text: Azure Migrate, Database Migration Service, and AzCopy move each workload type through its appropriate staged path.
